title: transit config.rs: cert_sha256 format not validated at config load
description: transit/src/config.rs PeerEntry validates that cert_sha256 is present when tls=true, but does not validate its format. The field is documented as 'colon-separated lowercase hex bytes e.g. aa:bb:cc:...' but any non-empty string passes config validation. A misconfigured fingerprint (wrong length, wrong separator, uppercase) will not be caught at startup and will only fail at TLS handshake time with a cryptic connection error — or silently fail to match and accept all peers. Maintenance consequence: operators will file bugs about TLS not working with no clear path to the misconfigured cert_sha256.
